issue_context.title: [turbopack] esm interrupt error when transform to lower browserslist_query
issue_context.body: ### What version of Turbopack are you using? 1.6.3 ### What package manager are you using / does the bug impact? npm ### What operating system are you using? Mac ### Describe the Bug import a cjs module in esm module with a lower browserslist_query, will throw `Uncaught ReferenceError: module is not defined`. ### Expected Behavior should not have the ReferenceError. ### To Reproduce Change the browserslist_query: ```js // index.js import lib from './lib.js'; console.log(lib()); ``` ```js // lib.js module.exports = async function() { return 1; } ``` ### Reproduction Repo _No response_
comments: It seems caused by SWC inject_helpers, [`lib.js` should be a cjs module but after `inject_helpers` it was transformed to a esm module](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.3.19&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA8vNTynNSdVLrSjILyopVrBVSCyuzEtWSCvNSy7JzM9TSMvTSCwq0lSo5lJQKEotKS3KUzDkquUCAOxwi%2Bc3AAAA&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WOSw7DMAhE78La23aRE3TTQyAXp678ExApUeS7F7eWwmoE82Y44SMelhMashAPJUdR3GEB8hnFc2wKzmy2CpiEugPalbhgelBqxAKL8kYOFHklHaTcDEm1Ck3IQY4lhmMU%2BJobk8h1wrImuuKVsUionIebCb3%2BRTDqbbLbGFVf26BO0KPRr%2FUO%2FSqa4VGe0zie7F94Qh4%2B8QAAAA%3D%3D), and this will [not happen in babel preset-env](https://babeljs.io/repl#?browsers=chrome%2050&build=&builtIns=false&corejs=false&spec=false&loose=false&code_lz=LYewJgrgNgpgdDAHgBxAJwC4GcAEBeHAQywE8A7AYxwDMJKMBLEMmsgCkLTQEocBvAFA4caGBghoWARgEBfAUA&debug=false&forceAllTransforms=false&shippedProposals=false&circleciRepo=&evaluate=false&fileSize=false&timeTravel=false&sourceType=module&lineWrap=false&presets=env%2Cstage-0%2Cstage-1%2Cstage-2%2Cstage-3%2Ctypescript&prettier=false&targets=Node-14&version=7.20.4&externalPlugins=%40babel%2Fplugin-transform-runtime%407.19.6&assumptions=%7B%7D).

We can pass that via TransformContext

It's used to generate a hash for the file.
